newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ share mkt closes up 1.3 pct on Dow, lower rates.
newsitem.headline: NZ share mkt closes up 1.3 pct on Dow, lower rates.

text.p: * NZ shares rally on Dow surge and lower interest rates
* Brokers predict market could rally further
* Interest rates seen as the key
Price movements at close
LAST CHG * NZSE40 cap index +28.63 at 2,305.24
323 +10 * NZSC cap index -1.87 at 5,037.12
329 +8 * NZMC .NZMC cap index +9.23 at 1,889.26
354 +4 * Volume NZ$75 million. Futures +10 at 1,147
656 +4 * Other movers - +14, +22
The New Zealand share market closed up 1.3 percent on Tuesday as investors reacted to the lower local interest rate environment and the Dow's record close.
Brokers said the rally could have more legs.
"The key is the lower interest rate environment," said Cavill White Securities' Richard Burton, who added that all the ingredients for a market rally were present except a pick-up in earnings.
The barometer top 40 index gained 28.63 points to 2,305.24 on good volume of $75 million.
Leading performers were the Fletcher stocks. Fletcher Paper, up eight to $3.29, and Carter Holt Harvey, up 10 to $3.23, responded to a three percent rise in the S&P paper index.
Brierley Investments ended three cents ahead at $1.33 as views firmed that the company would make money from its investment in its Fairfax investment, the subject of takeover talk.
Fletcher Energy rose 14 cents to $4.46 as it continued to be rerated on Monday's announcement of a farm-out agreement in Brunei.
Burton said the price rise of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell warrants on some stocks, Fletcher Paper and Fletcher Energy in particular, did not reflect the rise in the underlying ordinary shares.
Brokers said Air New Zealand had broken its downward spiral, closing up four to $3.00.
The property, retail and electricity sectors have all prospered under the lower interest rate regime of the last week.
-- Simon Louisson, Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
